summary: Estimate scan-bound sensitivity maps from complex coil images.
notes: This shared estimator accepts complex coil images so the future exact contract can define Cartesian or non-Cartesian acquisition/calibration provenance without duplicating map estimation in each consumer Provider. It must also define map semantics, key/epoch projection, completion, finite retention, resource bounds, and terminal behavior. Its immutable sensitivity-map output reaches Cartesian SENSE, non-Cartesian SENSE, and adaptive coil combination only through future explicit calibration bindings; it is never implicit shared Provider state.
